assumption: Initial MI sizing is design-level only; exact vCores/storage require live telemetry.
validation_required: Collect CPU, IO, waits, storage growth, concurrency, and query baselines.
impact_if_wrong: Wrong sizing could cause cost waste or performance regression.

assumption: Flexible Server compute/storage requirements are estimated from synthetic billing profile.
validation_required: Collect production volume, connection count, vacuum/write profile, and month-end load.
impact_if_wrong: Wrong sizing could affect billing availability or cost.

assumption: Production should use private connectivity for data-plane services.
validation_required: Validate corporate network, DNS, firewall, and administrative access requirements.
impact_if_wrong: Wrong assumptions could block application connectivity.

assumption: Jobs should use job compute; interactive clusters are for development only.
validation_required: Validate workload SLAs, concurrency, Lakeflow fit, and serverless availability.
impact_if_wrong: Wrong model could increase cost or reduce operational control.

assumption: Service-managed keys are acceptable unless policy requires customer-managed keys.
validation_required: Validate security policy and regulatory requirements.
impact_if_wrong: CMK later could affect deployment sequence and operations.

assumption: RTO/RPO tiers come from Milestone 3 synthetic estate requirements.
validation_required: Confirm contractual service commitments with business owners.
impact_if_wrong: Wrong recovery targets could over- or under-engineer HA/DR.

assumption: AI-enabled SQL/search/RAG is a future boundary, not implemented architecture.
validation_required: Validate use cases, access controls, evaluation, and token/search cost drivers.
impact_if_wrong: Premature AI design could duplicate data or bypass governance.
